title: Monotonicity of the propagation speed with respect to the diffusion in a Lotka-Volterra competition-diffusion system
summary: In this paper, we study the dependence of the propagation speed on the diffusion ratio in a Lotka-volterra competition-diffusion system under strong competition. The model is known to admits a unique monotone travelling front connecting two exclusion equilibria and the sign of its speed determines which species invades the territory occupied by the other. We establish smoothness results for the wave speed and the wave profile.
